basic_profile.bio: A longtime fan of crime and suspense dramas, especially those from Asia. I've been captivated by storytelling since childhood, which led me to pursue a career as a scriptwriter. Born and raised in Toronto, Canada, I'm currently working for a small indie film company. In my leisure, I enjoy exploring new crime series, dabbling in creative writing, and occasionally diving into speculative fiction. Typically online in the evenings, I often engage in discussions about my favorite shows. Single and enjoying the freedom to explore my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught enthusiast of Asian crime dramas with an extensive background in scriptwriting. My passion for storytelling and suspenseful narratives has driven me to explore various international series. I regularly analyze plot structures and character development, which enhances my scriptwriting skills.
